text: This report summarizes the site history and past Council decisions related to City-owned land at 1555 Danforth Avenue, as referred in item IE23.10 . While the site is maintained by Parks and Recreation as green space, it is under the jurisdiction of Toronto Parking Authority. This report outlines the required steps for implementing a jurisdictional transfer from Toronto Parking Authority to Parks and Recreation and a naming as "Coxwell Commons".
The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. Received the report (September 4, 2025) from the General Manager, Parks and Recreation for information.
